name: game-over
description: Reach the GAME OVER banner (single player exhausts its last life) and pixel-validate the game-over sequence vs MAME.
_grounding: coin@400 + 1P start@500; one-shot poke LIVES_REMAINING 0xAD00=1 and its save block 0xAD10=1 @650, then force death 0xA800=0xF0 @660 (ship alive from f612). At f954 loseLifeAndHandOver(0x11ed) brings lives to 0 and tail-calls postGameOverBanner(0x1253): SEQUENCE_DELAY 0xA9EB=0xB4, GAME OVER glyph 0x7D at 0xA672. Held ~180 frames then returns to attract. Deterministic, no entropy.

pixel_invisible.fileScoreAfterGameOverHoldElsePassTurn: each in-window run ticks SEQUENCE_DELAY, a RAM-only hold; only its expiry (score not filed, turn passes) changes the screen
